models.description: Fee varies with guests actually in-house; marketed for seasonal properties; can result in zero charge for a closed period

kwentra.minimumScope: Front Office module in every subscription
kwentra.switchingModels: Only when the current term expires
kwentra.billing: Card on file, or invoice: per-room fees net 30 days; occupancy-based invoiced no later than 45 days after period start; fees exclude VAT
kwentra.upgradesDowngrades: Upgrades pro-rated to next billing date; downgrades limited, no refunds, effective at term end
kwentra.refunds: All payment obligations non-cancellable; all amounts non-refundable
kwentra.cancellation: Written notice 60+ days before subscription expiry; data deleted from backups within 30 days of termination
kwentra.nonPayment: Notice, suspension possible 10 days later; re-activation fees may apply
kwentra.vendorTermination: May suspend or terminate accounts for any reason at any time
kwentra.sla: None; no guarantee of uninterrupted or error-free operation
kwentra.liability: No liability for lost profits or indirect damages; not responsible for third-party-caused data loss
kwentra.freeTrial: Conflicting: Capterra yes, Software Advice no; demo is free
